5.  **Completion Check:**

    *   I have sent the confirmation email to the partners.
    *   The task definition says: "The task is complete when the booking has been created in the booking system and the confirmation email has been sent to the partners."
6.  **Conclusion:** Both conditions for task completion have been met. My work is done. I should now end my session.I have completed all my assigned tasks. The meeting has been booked by Alison and I have sent the confirmation email to all four partners. The task is now complete.
